# Agent Reach (vendored)

- Source: https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach
- Commit: 94f06c1969dfc1834001269d79d3ad0972d9dee6
- Version: 1.5.0
- Licence: MIT (see LICENSE in this folder)

This folder is a copy of the upstream `agent_reach` package, taken for Meridian's optional research tooling. It is not imported by the Meridian app. Meridian runs it only through `scripts/agent-reach.mjs`, in check mode by default. Update it by copying a newer commit here and recording the new SHA.
